coder_notes: Active moiety given as the INN form stated in the record ('Lutetium (177Lu)oxodotreotide'); isotope also in drug_class_hint; script may normalise to oxodotreotide. Temozolomide (registered as Other) and radiotherapy are the SOC backbone in Group 1 only; Group 3 is single-agent 177Lu-DOTATATE. Lysine-arginine renal protection solution is not a registered intervention but every dose is co-administered with it; listed as two supportive components. SSTR expression: every participant is assessed by 68Ga-DOTATATE PET at screening, but tumour uptake is an explicit inclusion criterion only under the Group 3 recurrent criteria, hence enrichment for Group 3. MGMT appears only in keywords, not in eligibility/design/outcomes, so not recorded. Tumour PK coded yes because tumour-lesion time-activity curves and absorbed dose (imaging dosimetry) quantify drug activity in tumour; blood PK also planned. No pharmacodynamic/target-modulation measurement stated (68Ga PET used for target expression at screening, not modulation).
